layers.message: Plan CI for the survey API

graderOnly: The scope and the technical design are complete and consistent; DEV-001 needs no upstream change.

uv is not installed in the run environment, and pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, astral.sh, the npm registries, and the Debian mirrors are blocked, so neither uv nor the apps' dependencies can be installed and the workflow's commands cannot be run locally.
The design leaves how each test run selects its Python version, how coverage reports are kept, triggers, caching, timeouts, and permissions to Developer as local implementation details.

the Python package registry is blocked, so uv and the apps' dependencies cannot be installed
the uv installer host is blocked
the repository has no GitHub Actions workflows yet

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'import re, tomllib; d = tomllib.load(open("apps/api/pyproject.toml", "rb")); assert d["project"]["requires-python"] == ">=3.11"; dev = {re.split("[<>=!~ ]", x)[0] for x in d["dependency-groups"]["dev"]}; assert {"pytest", "pytest-cov", "ruff", "mypy"} <= dev, dev; assert d["tool"]["uv"]["sources"]["shared"]["path"] == "../../packages/shared"; print("ok")'
selfChecks.why: apps/api declares requires-python >=3.11, the dev group with pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, and mypy, and the path source to packages/shared

selfChecks.cmd: grep -qx 3.12 apps/api/.python-version && test -f apps/api/uv.lock && test -f apps/worker/uv.lock && grep -qx 3.12 apps/worker/.python-version
selfChecks.why: both apps pin 3.12 in .python-version and have a uv.lock

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layers 50-52 (pre-install) commit the fieldwork monorepo in three commits: packages/shared (hatchling package with shared/__init__.py), apps/api (FastAPI on uv; pyproject with requires-python >=3.11, dependencies fastapi, uvicorn, shared, dev group pytest/pytest-cov/ruff/mypy/httpx, uv path source to ../../packages/shared, hatchling build packaging app, ruff/mypy/pytest config, no coverage config; .python-version 3.12; short uv.lock; README listing the five commands; small app and tests), and apps/worker (second uv service on packages/shared, .python-version 3.12, uv.lock) plus the full root README. No .github directory and no coverage threshold anywhere. Layer 60 commits the cycle: STATE.md (DEVELOPING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, BlockedOn NONE, recovery and obligations inactive, cycle id from the case), MODE.md BROWNFIELD, CONTEXT.md, the scope with AC-001 and AC-002 as worded in the case, the technical design (CI only, .github/workflows/api-ci.yml, the five commands run in apps/api, actions by major version tag; silent on Python selection, coverage retention, triggers, caching, timeouts, permissions), and the APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan (User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE) with one PENDING step DEV-001 mapped to AC-001, AC-002. runtime.blockHosts covers the package registries, Debian mirrors, and astral.sh; uv is absent from the image (selfCheck). Assertion checks follow the catalog notes.
